summary: Add explicitly selected collection-scoped ordered-membership HTTP pages with authoritative metadata and non-expiring keyset continuations

schema.detail: No persistent schema change. HTTP query dispatch uses the existing API-owned metadata wrapper; generated client integration remains separate.

rules.detail: Existing authentication, arrangement owner authorization, response budgets and membership projection rules remain authoritative.

compatibility.detail: The existing membership route accepts paging_contract=collection-v1. Selected pages require paging_contract and membership metadata; mixed cursor contracts are rejected. Requests without the selector retain legacy page fields and cursor semantics. Unsupported selectors or collections return unsupported-membership-paging-contract. No capability is advertised.

downtime.detail: No migration or service downtime is required.

manual.detail: No client activation is included; typed client and stream support remain separate slices.

recovery.detail: Selected collection changes and scope resets return distinct restart errors. Cursors retain no transaction or lease and do not expire solely due to time.
